problem: oxlint is now a default source; a project already naming oxlint gets oxlint findings on its first run after upgrade, scored against a baseline taken before oxlint was measured. The baseline stores only {health_score, risk_score} with no source set, and is written only when empty.
impact: An unchanged tree flips gate PASS -> FAIL ('health regression N vs baseline'); keryx health gate and the flow-completion health gate exit 1 until someone re-baselines by hand. One oxlint error on a 2000-LOC project reaches failOnRegressionDrop.
suggested_fix: Record the measured source set with the baseline; exclude findings from sources the baseline did not measure from the regression delta (or treat them as trend unknown) and re-accept the baseline for the new source. Test: runHealth twice on one tree, without then with an oxlint intent signal; the gate must not move to FAIL.
evidence: probe-pass-to-fail.ts against the a407ce25 snapshot: run1 pass complete health 100; run2 (package.json names oxlint, stub oxlint prints 3 error diagnostics, 2000 LOC) fail complete health 70 regression 30. Verifier re-ran it: confirmed.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Traced every consumer of regression_score / baseline health_score in the blast-radius set (keryx ctx rg over scopes.ts, scoring.ts, baseline.ts), then followed the gate verdict to its exit-code consumers.

verification.evidence: probe-pass-to-fail.ts against the snapshot's runHealth: 'run1 pass complete health 100' then 'run2 fail complete health 70 regression 30 / FAIL: health regression 30 vs baseline'; probe-baseline.ts: run1 health 100 regression 0, run2 fail health 70 regression 30. Needs only a pre-oxlint baseline plus oxlint findings on an oxlint-naming project.

problem: After the family moved to capability, the 'only skipped is excused' tests (missing and configured-but-failed) build eslint without capability, so eslint is outside the family and the tests pass whether or not excusedByLintFamily checks status === 'skipped'.
impact: The guard that keeps a half-installed required linter blocking is untested; removing it would let a missing or configured-but-failed required eslint pass whenever oxlint ran.
suggested_fix: Build those eslint records with capability 'lint' (e.g. a lintBroken(name, status) helper next to lintRan/lintSkipped).
evidence: Mutation gate.ts `lintSatisfied && isLinter(s) && s.status === "skipped"` -> `lintSatisfied && isLinter(s)`: bun test src/health 168 pass / 0 fail. With capability added to the two records the mutant goes red. Verifier: confirmed on the snapshot.
quote: const sources = [lintRan("oxlint"), source({ source: "eslint", status: "missing", required: true })];

sites: src/health/gate.test.ts 'AC3: only `skipped` is excused -- a missing required eslint still blocks'
src/health/gate.test.ts 'AC3: a required eslint that ran and FAILED to parse still blocks'
class_scope.enumeration_method: Every gate test that asserts a lint-family source stays blocking was read; only these two build the blocked linter via source() instead of lintRan/lintSkipped, which set capability.

verification.evidence: gate.ts `lintSatisfied && isLinter(s) && s.status === "skipped";` -> `lintSatisfied && isLinter(s);`: bun test --timeout 30000 src/health 168 pass, 0 fail (28 files). Restored, cmp-verified.

problem: filteredInfo (the --source filter path) builds SourceRunInfo without the adapter's capability, unlike runAdapter. A filtered-out required eslint stays INCOMPLETE only because the field is absent, not by a rule in the gate; no test pins it; filtered and unfiltered reports disagree on eslint's capability.
impact: Making the report consistent later (copying capability in filteredOutcome) would silently excuse a filtered-out required linter. Also raised by review-logic (L2-02, info).
suggested_fix: Pass the adapter to filteredOutcome and copy capability; mark filtered sources explicitly (e.g. filtered: true) and exclude them from the family excuse in the gate; add a gate test and a docs clause.
evidence: run.ts: runAdapter spreads adapter.capability into base; filteredInfo has no capability and is reached via filteredOutcome(adapter.id, cfg). Verifier: site-check only (unverifiable).

verification.evidence: keryx ctx rg 'filteredInfo|capability' src/health/run.ts: runAdapter spreads capability at line 342; filteredInfo at line 506 has none, called at lines 113, 133, 503. Shape confirmed; no harm executed.

problem: Real oxlint 1.81.0 with no files to lint prints 'No files found to lint. Please check your paths and ignore patterns.' on stdout before the JSON and exits 1; JSON.parse fails and the report says the format was not recognized.
impact: Outcome is correct (configured-but-failed, required eslint keeps blocking) but the stated cause sends the operator to debug a nonexistent format mismatch.
suggested_fix: Recognise the 'No files found to lint' preamble: strip it before parsing, or return a dedicated closed-vocabulary error added to KNOWN_VALIDATION_ERRORS.
evidence: Real oxlint in an empty dir: exit 1, stdout begins with the plain-text line; snapshot oxlintAdapter.validate returned {valid:false, error:'oxlint JSON format was not recognized'}. Verifier: confirmed.
quote:
let data: unknown;
  try { data = JSON.parse(content); } catch { return null; }

verification.evidence: Real oxlint 1.81.0 `--format json .` in an empty dir: exit 1, stdout 'No files found to lint. Please check your paths and ignore patterns.' then JSON with diagnostics [] and number_of_files 0. Snapshot oxlintAdapter.validate -> {valid:false, error:'oxlint JSON format was not recognized'}.

problem: Severity mapping for 'advice' or a missing severity is untested.
impact: A refactor could promote advice-level or severity-less diagnostics to P1 unnoticed.
suggested_fix: Add parse cases with severity 'advice' and with severity deleted, asserting P2/warning.
evidence: Mutation to `severity !== "warning"`: bun test src/health 168 pass / 0 fail. Verifier: confirmed.

verification.evidence: oxlint.ts `diagnostic.severity === "error"` -> `diagnostic.severity !== "warning"`: bun test --timeout 30000 src/health 168 pass, 0 fail. Restored, cmp-verified.
